reached_sql:
SELECT
    b.i_item_id,
    b.s_state,
    grouping(b.s_state) AS g_state,
    SUM(b.sum_ss_quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(b.cnt_ss_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
    SUM(b.sum_ss_list_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(b.cnt_ss_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
    SUM(b.sum_ss_coupon_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(b.cnt_ss_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
    SUM(b.sum_ss_sales_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(b.cnt_ss_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        st.s_state,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
        COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price
    FROM
        (SELECT s_store_sk, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('TN','TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')) AS st
        JOIN store_sales AS ss ON st.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
        JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary') AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
        JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999) AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, st.s_state
) AS b
GROUP BY ROLLUP (b.i_item_id, b.s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100

raw_sql: select i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 from store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, store, item where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_gender = 'M' and cd_marital_status = 'W' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and d_year = 1999 and s_state in ('TN','TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN') group by rollup (i_item_id, s_state) order by i_item_id ,s_state limit 100
